verdict.rationale: API parity with the UI is a fair question for a SaaS accounting product, so the axis applies. The pack only notes that a GraphQL API reportedly lives on a developer portal that returned 403, so nothing about its coverage could be quoted. Wave's marketing pages document no API surface, and the openapi and llms.txt probes all returned 404. There is no evidence that UI functionality is reachable through an API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
